steps.action: Separate operation effect from returned value shape. Preserve executor/loader capability taint on actual returned fields; model descriptors/prototypes as structured or opaque values instead of applying one executor bit to everything.
steps.limits: Unknown intrinsic identity or unknown receiver retains origin effect and refusal. No blanket Object/Reflect exemption.

steps.action: Extend existing own-scalar stableInitializer proof to closed data shapes and finite key sets. Record receiver allocation, lexical identity, aliases, every write and escape; conservative rejection is acceptable.
steps.limits: Own property only; no spreads, computed definitions, __proto__, accessors, methods, Proxy/external inputs, unknown calls, writes or exports in first implementation.

steps.action: Add intrinsic operation summaries only behind an explicit pristine-intrinsics authority. getOwnPropertyDescriptor returns optional descriptor with boolean metadata and value/get/set capability summaries. getPrototypeOf returns opaque prototype tokens. Reflect.get returns the proven own data field.
steps.limits: Keep arbitrary construct, prototype dereference, general reflection exports and dynamic evaluator/module references unverified.

steps.action: Propagate through lexical aliases and assignments to a monotone finite fixed point; use budget exhaustion => Unknown. Suggested bounds: 16 keys/unions, depth 64, 4096 local proof nodes; these are proposed constants requiring builder review.
steps.limits: Do not turn partial traversal into proof; preserve assignment-pattern/default-parameter and shadowing behavior.

steps.action: For CommonJS helper metadata, analyze exact helper bodies and exact literal source namespace export summaries. Preserve forwarded getter/value capabilities.
steps.limits: A matching helper fingerprint establishes syntax, not trusted from/to objects or export semantics. Existing module closure and effect summaries are necessary.

steps.action: Validate parser-only regression matrix before any attempt at scoped scanner runs in builder-owned snapshot. Bind any eliminated ordinal to its new proof certificate, source hash and assumptions.
steps.limits: No projected elimination count, no installed-tree verdict, no acceptance exceptions and no pass on residual Unknown.

contractsNeeded: Trusted pristine Object/Reflect/Symbol and descriptor allocation semantics must be enforced by trusted bootstrap/realm policy or shown by a complete relevant closure; lexical global spelling, const alias and absence of writes in one file are insufficient.

Core serialization inputs must be recursively JSON data created by a trusted parse/allocation boundary, never attacker-defined Proxy/accessor objects. Object.getPrototypeOf equality and Object.freeze do not prove this.
Module helper inputs require exact runtime physical closure, export/getter summaries, and mutation/callback analysis. Declaration files and package labels cannot certify runtime.

Process/worker/codegen/toolchain execution requires an explicit restricted execution/module policy if the overall contract is intended to permit it; generated-code text may be analyzed inertly but unknown callbacks/options/global access remain unresolved.

limitations: 1,610 identities are historical input. No original scanner or original fixture program was executed.
1,406 family classifications are structural attributions, not eliminated diagnostics; 204 remain PENDING.
787 classified identities have unique AST span binding; 619 use homogeneous line-group candidate sets, without asserting same-line ordinal order.
The independent provenance model intentionally covers only a finite syntactic subset; it is not the checker and not a sound acceptance verifier. Cardinality or family ambiguities remain PENDING.
No current installed completion, global pass, release, or runtime closure proof is claimed. No scope exclusion based on vendor/test/dev/field/reflection labels.
The finite action manifest and guards provide scoped evidence, not kernel syscall tracing. No original payload was executed.
